slides.title: Moyale: Kenya now counts 35,000 arrivals
slides.body: Overnight update from the Ethiopia–Kenya border

slides.title: Ethiopians crossed into Kenya
slides.body: said Marsabit County Commissioner Stanley Kamande. About 15,000 in camps, 20,000 with local families.

slides.title: Overcrowded camps, measles fears
slides.body: Three suspected measles cases were isolated, Moyale's health officer said. Tents, blankets and toilets are urgently needed.

slides.title: No confirmed death toll
slides.body: Residents told AFP heavy weapons were fired in town. AFP could not verify tolls; the federal government had not responded.

slides.title: Protect civilians on both sides of the border
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Kenya News Agency via Zegabi, Oct 25 · AFP, Oct 24, 2026
